record.body:
## Rationale

Discuss and plan review are already records, so the next session still sees them. Close and "start the next phase" were only asked in chat, so they vanish when the session ends. workflow-loop, session-analysis, and dashboard are all past their last phase with their goals still open. Advancing into the next existing gate keeps the human stops and makes the handoff between them survive.

## Counter-argument

Running the next phase with no discuss and no plan review finishes more work per sitting, and only stops for failures, a needs-human finding, or a push or merge. Recording the close question without also starting the next phase is a smaller change and still clears the stuck efforts. Chaining into discuss or plan review makes every phase boundary a conversation, including a phase whose approach was already obvious.

payload.alternatives: Only record the close question and wait for the user to ask to continue; plan and run the next phase with no discuss and no plan review
payload.choice: After a phase gate passes, continue into discuss when the next named phase has no decision, otherwise into plan-phase, which stops on its plan-review question. When no planned phase remains, open a blocking continuity-question scoped close-effort:<slug> and do not close the effort in that turn.

record.subject: next-gate-continuation
